title: Hook
text: Look at the room around you. Every wall, every shadow, every inch of empty space feels deep and solid.
nxt: But some physicists ask a startling question. What if all of that depth is described by information written on a flat surface?

title: The Honest Part
text: Now the honest part. This does not mean you are a picture. It is a statement about how much information describes a region of space.
nxt: It has not been proven for our universe, and nobody has shown that the room around you is a projection.
